description: This file contains unit tests for the EventHub queue cache eviction and purge strategies, as well as cache pressure management within the Orleans streaming framework. It defines a test class 'EHPurgeLogicTests' with multiple test methods to validate cache behavior under different pressure and time conditions, utilizing mock objects and setup routines.

classes.name: EHPurgeLogicTests
classes.description: Unit test class for examining cache eviction and purge logic in Orleans EventHub streaming.

methods.name: EventHubQueueCache_WontPurge_WhenUnderPressure
methods.description: Tests that caches are not purged when under cache pressure.

methods.name: EventHubQueueCache_WontPurge_WhenTimePurgePredicateSaysDontPurge
methods.description: Validates that caches are not purged when the time-based purge predicate indicates so.

methods.name: EventHubQueueCache_WillPurge_WhenTimePurgePredicateSaysPurge_And_NotUnderPressure
methods.description: Checks that caches are purged when the time predicate signals and pressure is not applied.

methods.name: EventHubQueueCache_EvictionStrategy_Behavior
methods.description: Verifies eviction strategy behavior, including buffer purging and re-allocation after purge.

methods.name: InitForTesting
methods.description: Initializes caches, eviction strategies, and receivers for tests.

methods.name: GetItemCountInAllCache
methods.description: Aggregates item counts across all caches.

methods.name: AddDataIntoCache
methods.description: Helper method to add test data into caches asynchronously.

methods.name: MakeEventData
methods.description: Creates mock EventData instances with specified sequence numbers.

methods.name: CheckPointerFactory
methods.description: Factory method to generate stream queue checkpointer instances.

methods.name: CacheFactory
methods.description: Creates and configures cache instances with eviction strategies for testing.
